description:
The sales clerks in a bank can use their software frontend to receive the credit-scoring for a certain customer. 
This starts a process in the banking system which communicates with the agency in the background. 
This process sends a scoring request to the agency right after the beginning. 
Then, the Agency does a first quick scoring (level 1). 
This will often lead to an immediate result which is then returned directly to the banking system within seconds. 
The banking process presents the result to the clerk sitting at the frontend. 
Sometimes the scoring cannot be determined immediately and takes longer. 
In this case the agency informs the banking process of the delay and then starts the level 2 scoring (which can take up to a couple of minutes). 
After the scoring result is determined, the information is sent back to the banking process. 
The banking process displays a message to the clerk when he receives information about the delay to check again later. 
As soon as the result arrives, it can be seen at the frontend.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_CreditScoring" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/credit-scoring">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CreditScoreRequest" name="Credit score request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ScoringRequest" name="Scoring request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ScoringResult" name="Scoring result"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_DelayNotification" name="Scoring delayed"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ResultDisplay" name="Show scoring result"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CheckLater" name="Show check again later"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_CreditScoring">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_SalesClerk" name="Sales Clerk Frontend"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Banking" name="Banking System" processRef="Process_Banking"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Agency" name="Credit Scoring Agency" processRef="Process_Agency"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_RequestFromClerk" name="Request credit scoring" sourceRef="Participant_SalesClerk" targetRef="StartEvent_ScoringRequested" messageRef="Message_CreditScoreRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ScoringRequest" name="Send scoring request" sourceRef="SendTask_ScoringRequest" targetRef="StartEvent_RequestReceived" messageRef="Message_ScoringRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Level1Result" name="Level 1 result" sourceRef="SendTask_ReturnImmediateResult" targetRef="CatchEvent_Level1Result" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DelayNotice" name="Delay notice" sourceRef="SendTask_NotifyDelay" targetRef="CatchEvent_DelayNotice" messageRef="Message_DelayNotification"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Level2Result" name="Level 2 result" sourceRef="SendTask_ReturnLevel2Result" targetRef="CatchEvent_Level2Result" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ShowCheckLater" name="Display check later" sourceRef="SendTask_ShowCheckLater" targetRef="Participant_SalesClerk" messageRef="Message_CheckLater"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ShowResult1" name="Display result" sourceRef="SendTask_PresentResult" targetRef="Participant_SalesClerk" messageRef="Message_ResultDisplay"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ShowResult2" name="Display result" sourceRef="SendTask_PresentResultLevel2" targetRef="Participant_SalesClerk" messageRef="Message_ResultDisplay"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Banking" name="Banking System Credit Scoring" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_ScoringRequested" name="Credit scoring requested">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_StartToSend</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_ScoringRequested" messageRef="Message_CreditScoreRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_ScoringRequest" name="Send scoring request to agency" messageRef="Message_ScoringRequest">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_StartToSend</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SendToGateway</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_AwaitAgency" name="Await agency response">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SendToGateway</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_GatewayToLevel1</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_GatewayToDelay</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:eventBasedGateway>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="CatchEvent_Level1Result" name="Level 1 result received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_GatewayToLevel1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Level1ToPresent</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Level1Result" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="CatchEvent_DelayNotice" name="Delay notice received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_GatewayToDelay</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DelayToCheckLater</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_DelayNotice" messageRef="Message_DelayNotification"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_PresentResult" name="Present result to clerk" messageRef="Message_ResultDisplay">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Level1ToPresent</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PresentToMerge1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_ShowCheckLater" name="Show message to check again later" messageRef="Message_CheckLater">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DelayToCheckLater</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CheckLaterToLevel2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="CatchEvent_Level2Result" name="Level 2 result received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CheckLaterToLevel2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Level2ToPresent</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Level2Result" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_PresentResultLevel2" name="Present result to clerk" messageRef="Message_ResultDisplay">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Level2ToPresent</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PresentToMerge2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ResultMerge" name="Result presented">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PresentToMerge1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PresentToMerge2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MergeToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ResultPresented" name="Scoring result presented to clerk">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MergeToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToSend" sourceRef="StartEvent_ScoringRequested" targetRef="SendTask_ScoringRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendToGateway" sourceRef="SendTask_ScoringRequest" targetRef="Gateway_AwaitAgency"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GatewayToLevel1" sourceRef="Gateway_AwaitAgency" targetRef="CatchEvent_Level1Result"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GatewayToDelay" sourceRef="Gateway_AwaitAgency" targetRef="CatchEvent_DelayNotice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Level1ToPresent" sourceRef="CatchEvent_Level1Result" targetRef="SendTask_PresentResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PresentToMerge1" sourceRef="SendTask_PresentResult" targetRef="Gateway_ResultMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DelayToCheckLater" sourceRef="CatchEvent_DelayNotice" targetRef="SendTask_ShowCheckLater"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckLaterToLevel2" sourceRef="SendTask_ShowCheckLater" targetRef="CatchEvent_Level2Result"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Level2ToPresent" sourceRef="CatchEvent_Level2Result" targetRef="SendTask_PresentResultLevel2"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PresentToMerge2" sourceRef="SendTask_PresentResultLevel2" targetRef="Gateway_ResultMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MergeToEnd" sourceRef="Gateway_ResultMerge" targetRef="EndEvent_ResultPresented"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Agency" name="Credit Scoring Agency Process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_RequestReceived" name="Scoring request received">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AgencyStartToL1</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_RequestReceived" messageRef="Message_ScoringRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_Level1Scoring" name="Perform level 1 scoring">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AgencyStartToL1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_L1ToGateway</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ImmediateResult" name="Scoring determined immediately?" default="Flow_NotImmediate">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_L1ToGateway</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Immediate</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotImmediate</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_ReturnImmediateResult" name="Return immediate result to banking system" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Immediate</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ImmediateToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ImmediateReturned" name="Immediate result returned">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ImmediateToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_NotifyDelay" name="Notify banking system of delay" messageRef="Message_DelayNotification">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotImmediate</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DelayToL2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_Level2Scoring" name="Perform level 2 scoring">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DelayToL2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_L2ToReturn</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_ReturnLevel2Result" name="Return level 2 result to banking system" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_L2ToReturn</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReturnL2ToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Level2Returned" name="Level 2 result returned">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReturnL2ToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AgencyStartToL1" sourceRef="StartEvent_RequestReceived" targetRef="Task_Level1Scoring"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_L1ToGateway" sourceRef="Task_Level1Scoring" targetRef="Gateway_ImmediateResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Immediate" sourceRef="Gateway_ImmediateResult" targetRef="SendTask_ReturnImmediateResult">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>Scoring determined immediately</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotImmediate" sourceRef="Gateway_ImmediateResult" targetRef="SendTask_NotifyDelay"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ImmediateToEnd" sourceRef="SendTask_ReturnImmediateResult" targetRef="EndEvent_ImmediateReturned"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DelayToL2" sourceRef="SendTask_NotifyDelay" targetRef="Task_Level2Scoring"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_L2ToReturn" sourceRef="Task_Level2Scoring" targetRef="SendTask_ReturnLevel2Result"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReturnL2ToEnd" sourceRef="SendTask_ReturnLevel2Result" targetRef="EndEvent_Level2Returned"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
